name: heart_disease_clinical
outcome_definition: Binary presence of coronary artery disease (source `num` > 0, i.e. any major vessel >50% narrowed) confirmed by cardiac catheterization / angiography - the CONFIRMING step of the ECG -> troponin -> angiography workup. Exercise-test SUMMARY NUMBERS (restecg, thalach, exang, oldpeak, slope - derived from an ECG trace, not the trace itself) plus clinical/lab values (age, sex, cp, trestbps, chol, fbs) are the raw inputs. A same-visit diagnostic classification, not longitudinal early detection.
display_name: Heart disease clinical risk (Cleveland cohort, tabular)

clinical_context.this_pipeline_covers: resting/exercise-test SUMMARY NUMBERS (restecg, thalach, exang, oldpeak, slope - not the raw waveform) plus clinical risk factors; label is angiography-confirmed disease presence
clinical_context.gap: troponin is NOT in this schema - the classic UCI Cleveland cohort (Detrano et al. 1989) predates routine high-sensitivity troponin testing. Flagged here rather than silently ignored; add a troponin column to required_fields once a cohort that has one is sourced.
clinical_context.not_the_same_as: This is NOT the raw-12-lead-ECG-waveform MI-pattern/abnormal-ECG detection model being built elsewhere in this repo (backend/run_raw_hybrid.py, PTB-XL, CNN+QML) - unrelated dataset, features and task, coincidentally sharing the words 'heart' and 'ECG'.

data_source.citation: Detrano et al. 1989, UCI Machine Learning Repository - Heart Disease (Cleveland Clinic Foundation subset)
data_source.access: not bundled - place a locally-sourced copy at data/heart_disease_clinical/processed.cleveland.data and run prepare.py; needs the same license review other third-party sources went through (FR-035) before the derived CSV is used for training
